---
name: Website or Twitch report
about: Report intrusive advertising, tracking, breakage, a false positive or a research finding
---
## URL and observation time

## Type
Advertising / tracking / navigation interference / broken tool / assessment correction / Twitch classification

## Environment
OS, browser and blocker versions, viewport, active lists and revisions, consent/login state (no credentials).

## Reproduction
Steps, expected result, actual result, delayed/scroll interactions, and behavior with Anti-Ad Tibia disabled.

## Evidence
Redacted screenshots or request details. Mark observations, simulations and assumptions separately. Do not include cookies, tokens or private account data.

## Preservation checks
Navigation, search, tools, playback/chat, keyboard focus and accessibility as applicable.
